title: Effective Mordell Conjecture for Curves of Genus at Least Two
exact_target: Can all rational points on every number-field curve of genus at least two be computed with a guaranteed stopping certificate?

sources.citation: Natalia Garcia-Fritz and Hector Pasten, "Effective Mordell for curves with enough automorphisms", arXiv:2503.10443 [math.NT], v1 dated 13 March 2025.
Effective Mordell for curves with enough automorphisms.
Computing genus 2 curves over Q whose Jacobian has good reduction away from 2.
